what_is_it.explanation: dbt enables data analysts and engineers to transform their data using software engineering practices like version control and testing. Users write select statements or models that dbt turns into tables and views inside a data warehouse. Version 2.0 is a ground-up rewrite in Rust, offering faster performance, stricter language specifications, and a single self-contained binary installation.
